card.name: The word Week in schedules
card.fires_on: The word "Week" (or "week") when it labels a time period in a schedule, such as "Week 1 Day 1" or "week of March 4". It is often capitalized and starts a table cell or heading.

modes.label: Week labels in dosing schedules
modes.description: "Week" begins a treatment-schedule entry followed by a number.

modes.label: Week in dated lists and headings
modes.description: "week" appears in course syllabi or news headings, such as "week of" a date.
